preview.text: China won the toss and chose to bowl first against Saudi Arabia in a T20 match at Selangor Turf Club, where the usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches is 144. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 97 per cent chance of rain and a temperature of about 29 degrees.

summary.text: Saudi Arabia won by 64 runs - 10 Overs game due to rain. SAU made 98-6, Waji Ul Hassan (c) top-scoring with 49 off 27 balls; Tian Senqun (c) took 3 for 22. CHN made 34-8, Tian Senqun (c) top-scoring with 13 off 22 balls; Hisham Shaikh took 2 for 2. Sides batting first at Selangor Turf Club usually make about 144.
